verdict.rationale: The evidence only says check deposit exists at some locations ("Select locations offer check deposit" and a "Check Deposit" feature label). It publishes none of the terms the story asks for: no supported banks, per-deposit fees, turnaround time, or handling of the physical check after deposit. A feature label is adjacent to published deposit terms, not the terms themselves.

support.subject: As a founder, check deposit terms are published — supported banks, per-deposit fees, turnaround time, and what happens to the physical check afterward
